programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: As autumn unfolds in the garden, Monty Don and Nigel make the most of the season and prepare for the winter ahead. Meanwhile Carol Klein is in Surrey looking at wild and cultivated heathers.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Carol Klein is in Hampshire with the great horticulturist, Roy Lancaster, appreciating the virtues of the often overlooked St John's wort. Joe Swift is out and about too and visits a very unusual allotment in Tottenham, North London.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty Don's garden at Longmeadow is thriving in the summer sunshine and is looking more beautiful by the day, but the warm, wet weather has meant the hedges are growing like crazy and are in need of a good haircut.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty Don has left Longmeadow this week to explore the beautiful gardens at RHS Hyde Hall in Essex. He seeks inspiration from their amazing dry garden and discovers how they manage to keep their lawns looking pristine in such a hot summer.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty turns his attention to his ornamental grass borders, Carol travels to Cheshire to view some heleniums, and Joe is treated to a Jamaican feast when he visits Moor Green Allotments in Birmingham.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: For many gardeners, the beginning of September is the start of a new season. Monty Don embraces this shift as he harvests an abundance of delicious produce, at the same time as looking ahead to the spring.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty Don adds some foxtail lilies to his dry garden, Carol Klein visits salvia expert William Dyson in Kent, and we meet a remarkable woman from a family of gardeners on the eve of her 100th birthday.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty Don cuts back his wildflower meadow and, with an eye on some early season colour next year, makes a start on planting up his spring containers. Joe Swift learns the importance of allotment bee keeping when he visits a plot in Bristol.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: As well as catching up with various tasks at Longmeadow, Monty Don meets world-renowned garden designer, Piet Oudolf, at his latest creation in Somerset. He gets to grips with Oudolf's iconic naturalistic planting and explains how we can adapt this style to our very own gardens. Meanwhile, Carol Klein goes tree climbing in Bristol to find out how important these precious havens are for urban wildlife.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: With the arrival of October, it is time to start thinking about getting some onions and garlic in the ground, and Monty Don shares his secrets on how to get a successful crop. Elsewhere, Carol Klein takes first-time gardeners Dan and Dominique for a day out in Devon. They are on the hunt for some seasonal inspiration for their new garden and what better place to look than RHS Rosemoor.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: We find out how Rachel de Thame got on over the past year as she attempted to grow her own cut flowers, and if you're still in a quandary about what to grow in your winter pots this year, Monty Don may well have the answer.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: As autumn gathers momentum, it's time to start putting the garden to bed for winter. Monty Don has some timely advice on what to do. Carol Klein meets a nurseryman in Herefordshire and together they indulge in the beauty of the Japanese maple.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: With autumn on the horizon, the seasonal planting of bulbs for spring-flowering begins at Longmeadow. Frances Tophill meets a gardener whose allotment is filled with both traditional and exotic vegetables and Toby Buckland visits The Newt in Somerset to find out about its chequered garden history and to explore its emergence as one of the UK's most exciting gardens.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: In the second of her films about botany, Carol Klein goes underground to unravel the mysteries of roots and why they are so important to the health of our plants. Joe Swift meets fashion icon, Dame Zandra Rhodes, to explore how the flowers she likes to grow have influenced her designs over the years.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty refreshes a container of overgrown herbs, plants alpines and revisits the shrub and perennial cuttings he took a few weeks ago. Arit Anderson meets a designer who is placing sustainability and the environment at the heart of her gardens.

programme.title: The Secret History of the British Garden
programme.desc: Starting his journey at the sole surviving garden of the 1600s, Levens Hall in Cumbria, Monty sets out to investigate what the gardens of this age would have looked like and what influenced and inspired their creation.

programme.title: The Secret History of the British Garden
programme.desc: Monty bases himself at Rousham House in Oxfordshire, designed by one of the first practitioners of the landscape movement, William Kent. It has survived almost unchanged since its completion in 1741.

programme.title: The Secret History of the British Garden
programme.desc: Monty Don explores the extraordinary transformations that occurred throughout the 19th century. As a result of an expanding empire, scientific and technological innovation and social change, British gardens became more exotic, more colourful and more widely accessible than ever before.

programme.title: The Secret History of the British Garden
programme.desc: Monty Don concludes his journey through Britain's gardening heritage by looking at how the nation's gardens have evolved over the last hundred years. He looks at the profound effect that two world wars had on the attitude to gardens and gardening.

programme.title: Monty Don's Adriatic Gardens
programme.desc: Monty travels to Europe and explores the influence of the Venetians on gardening. To begin with, he explores Venice on one of the city's famous barges, stepping out to visit green spaces large and small that are often hidden from view behind high walls.

programme.title: Monty Don's Adriatic Gardens
programme.desc: Monty begins in the city of Trieste, close to Italy's border with Croatia, to visit a public garden first created by an obsessive royal plantsman more than 150 years ago, which is now being carefully restored. He then heads down the Adriatic coast through Croatia to pick up the trail that the Venetians followed, ending his journey on the beautiful island of Lopud, near Dubrovnik.

programme.title: Monty Don's Adriatic Gardens
programme.desc: Monty begins the last leg of his journey in Corfu, a Greek island with strong Venetian links, including olive trees planted by them that are still grown today. Here, Monty visits a spectacular garden made by an Englishman with Greek connections.

programme.title: Monty Don's Italian Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don conducts a personal grand tour around Italy's magnificent gardens from the luxurious retreats of the moneyed north to the lavish hideaways of the romantic south. In this episode, he's in and around Rome, a powerbase of emperors and popes, to explore gardens that are among some of the most extravagant and flamboyant ever created in history.

programme.title: Monty Don's Italian Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don is on a grand tour around Italy, this time visiting gardens both in Florence and around the sun-scorched Tuscan countryside. Monty discovers how, like a piece of sculpture, renaissance gardens were created as works of art, and how a group of Edwardian ex-pats mistakenly reinforced the idea that formal Italian gardens were flowerless.

programme.title: Monty Don's Italian Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don continues his grand garden tour of Italy. This time he is in Naples to visit some of the most sublime, romantic retreats in southern Italy. After all the formality of the green gardens around Rome and Florence, Monty seeks out idyllic horticultural gems set against the dramatic scenery of the Amalfi Coast to discover why, in the south, gardens are informal and, above all, filled with flowers.

programme.title: Monty Don's Italian Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don concludes his garden tour of Italy in the wealthy north where, in the Veneto and Lucca, extravagant pleasure gardens were created for flirtation and fun. In the Lakes, Monty meets up with the garden society, the Grandi Giardini Italiani, to peer over the fence at luxurious creations of the rich and famous. The journey ends on Lake Maggiore to see the most theatrical horticultural gem of Italy.
programme.sub-title: The Veneto, Lucca and The Lakes

programme.desc: Follows Captain Alexi Vostrikov (Harrison Ford) who, at the height of the Cold War, is ordered to take over command of the nuclear missile submarine K-19, pride of the Soviet Navy. His assignment: Prepare the K-19 for sea and take her out on patrol -- no matter what the cost. But problems with the K-19 arise that may lead to a core meltdown and explosion that will certainly kill all aboard, and possibly trigger a nuclear war. Vostrikov must choose between his orders and the lives of his men.

programme.title: A Midnight Clear
programme.desc: In the winter of 1944, American soldiers led by Will Knott (Ethan Hawke) are assigned to capture a small squad of German soldiers posted in France's Ardennes forest. Tired of war, the Americans have already lost half their division and discover that their German enemy is equally unwilling to fight. With Jewish soldier Stan Shutzer (Arye Gross) interpreting, the Germans and Americans agree on a plan that will let the former surrender without violence -- but then, tragedy strikes.

programme.title: The Battle of Algiers
programme.desc: Paratrooper commander Colonel Mathieu (Jean Martin), a former French Resistance fighter during World War II, is sent to 1950s Algeria to reinforce efforts to squelch the uprisings of the Algerian War. There he faces Ali la Pointe (Brahim Haggiag), a former petty criminal who, as the leader of the Algerian Front de Liberation Nationale, directs terror strategies against the colonial French government occupation. As each side resorts to ever-increasing brutality, no violent act is too unthinkable.

programme.title: Eraserhead
programme.desc: Henry (John Nance) resides alone in a bleak apartment surrounded by industrial gloom. When he discovers that an earlier fling with Mary X (Charlotte Stewart) left her pregnant, he marries the expectant mother and has her move in with him. Things take a decidedly strange turn when the couple's baby turns out to be a bizarre lizard-like creature that won't stop wailing. Other characters, including a disfigured lady who lives inside a radiator, inhabit the building and add to Henry's troubles.

programme.title: Eyes Without a Face
programme.desc: Dr. Génessier (Pierre Brasseur) is riddled with guilt after an accident that he caused disfigures the face of his daughter, the once beautiful Christiane (Edith Scob), who outsiders believe is dead. Dr. Génessier, along with accomplice and laboratory assistant Louise (Alida Valli), kidnaps young women and brings them to the Génessier mansion. After rendering his victims unconscious, Dr. Génessier removes their faces and attempts to graft them on to Christiane's.

He lives at home with his mother (Marcia Jean Kurtz) and spends much of his free time extolling the virtues of his favorite football team on sports radio. One night, Paul and his best friend, Sal (Kevin Corrigan), spy Giants linebacker Quantrell Bishop in their neighborhood and follow him to a strip club. Paul decides to approach his idol, but the encounter goes very badly.

programme.title: Basquiat
programme.desc: Despite living a life of extreme poverty in Brooklyn, graffiti artist Jean-Michel Basquiat (Jeffrey Wright) strives to rise up through the heady New York art scene of the 1970s and 1980s. He becomes the brightest star of neo-Expressionist painting and one of the most successful painters of his time, and even develops a friendship with Andy Warhol (David Bowie). But Basquiat's tumultuous life, specifically his addiction to heroin, overshadows his rise to fame, threatening all.

What follows is a series of unexpected twists and complications. Can Gowtham navigate this escalating crisis and find a way out?

How the duo, who hail from a respectable family in the village, tackles the wrath of villagers forms the story.

Ansari has now got a new case in the mid of all the chaos where one guy, Laksh (Karan Hariharan) has been found unconscious on beach. He is brutally hurt his head and lost substantial part of his memory.

programme.title: Sagaa

All is well, until a terrorist group led by Colonel Chikara (Rami Reddy) hides a bag of 'Crypton', a nuclear missile material, in Vikas's car while fleeing from the police. Unable to trace it later, the terrorists kidnap Vikas and his girlfriend, and bully Sunil into bringing the bag to them.

But Reema has another unruly suitor Vicky (Gulshan Grover) who would stop at nothing to claim her. Reema's father too wants her to marry Vicky, the son of a dangerous gangster he is indebted to. With her father's blessings in place, Vicky has nothing to fear.

After inadvertently making more money than expected on one of the robberies, the criminals decide they have collected enough funds to retire. But the cops -- including Lt. Macgruder (Bruce Payne) and Karen (Natasha Henstridge), a police detective -- refuse to let the adrenaline junkies skate away so easily.

programme.title: A Frozen Christmas 3

programme.title: Ebenezer the Traveler
programme.desc: Following the merriest Christmas day of Ebenezer Scrooge's long and miserable life, the day after finds him much less merry, and instead much more dead. Reunited with his old partner Jacob Marley, a no longer quite so Tiny Tim, and his beloved sister Fan, together they are tasked with earning their own redemptions, and regaining Scrooge's second chance, by crossing over time and the mortal plane to help guide others who are in danger of losing their way.

programme.desc: It's Christmas and the charming city of York, home to Jules, 16 and her Dad, David is decked out ready for the festive season. In many ways, David and Jules' relationship is no different from that of most fathers and their sixteen-year-old daughters. He struggles to understand her, she refuses to communicate with him. He wants to be involved in her life, she wants her own space.

programme.desc: Rudy celebrates Christmas every single day. He's a uncool Christmas Freak with no friends. A sassy angel helps Rudy discover there is more to life than Christmas.

programme.desc: When a woman learns of her high school reunion a week before Christmas, she's ecstatic to finally have her chance to win back the one that got away.

programme.desc: Teenagers Kara and Jessie strike up an unlikely friendship while sitting next to each other on a plane that's bound for the heartland. Forced to spend the holidays in the same small town with relatives that they've never met, the girls devise a plan to switch places for Christmas. Jessie soon finds herself living lavishly with Kara's wealthy grandparents, while Kara starts to bond with Jessie's fun, quirky grandmother and the most genuine, modest family that she's ever known.

programme.title: Cupid's Christmas
programme.desc: As Santa Claus searches for his lost Reindeer (Cupid) in the small town of Holly; the love story of Katie Valentine and Army veteran/firefighter Luke Murphy is re-ignited during an effort to save the historic town train depot by raising the funds necessary for its restoration and renovation. All the while, Katie's young niece Olivia goes on a mission to prove to her family that Santa Claus is real and the reindeer seen around town really is Cupid a member of Santa's sleigh team.

programme.title: DWB: Dating While Black
programme.desc: DWB: Dating While Black is a very honest and comedic look at the dating process of through the eyes of several individuals. Two former co-workers, Eric and Alex, have been recently laid off of their jobs and they run into each other on a job interview. While searching for new jobs, they forge a personal relationship that involves Alex, a womanizing ladies' man, helping the naive and recently dumped Eric understand women better.

programme.title: Bachelorette's Degree
programme.desc: "Bachelorette's Degree" is a steamy romantic comedy set in Washington, D.C., and explores the dynamics of love and friendship, tested by unexpected circumstances. The film stars three beautiful, successful women as they debunk the notion of women racing for the marriage altar. Instead, it tells the other side of the story. Dennie is a publicist for a national television personality. Jasmine has just finished law school and Kerra Carter is a seasoned middle school teacher.

programme.title: Behind Treasure's Door

programme.title: The Perfect Wife 2
programme.desc: Recently widowed Allan Williams meets fellow Houstonian Erica Bryant. She quickly sweeps him off his feet with her sexual prowess and marries him shortly after. programme.title: The Break of Dawn
programme.desc: After leaving an abusive relationship, college student Dawn Monae discovers that her ex has committed suicide. After some time, she meets a man named Keith online, but her roommates suspect that he isn't who he says he is. Little do they know, he has an agenda that no one saw coming.

programme.title: Played
programme.desc: A big time drug dealer and his fashion model girlfriend are ready to settle down and get married. However, he falls to temptation with a woman who could crush everything he has built.

programme.title: Hostile Takedown
programme.desc: 9 years ago Alex, a former cop, lost his partner Dennis, when he was assassinated execution style to a vicious murderer. Unable to cope, Alex resigns from the force and finds himself dealing with past ghosts and the guilt he feels for his fallen partner. But when a madman takes over a local mall where Alex is shopping, and threatens the lives of innocent victims, Alex is forced back to his former duties and quickly learns the madman has ties to his slain partner. Will justice be served?

programme.title: DIRT
programme.desc: Derek "Dirt" Roberts is the top lieutenant for Big Boss, a criminal mastermind who rose through the ranks from a "corner boy" to become the city's most powerful organized criminal. When the two grow apart, Dirt hatches an elaborate plan to leave the organization. This plan is interrupted when he comes face to face with Clutch, a rogue detective on a mission to find and rescue his partner and clear his name.

programme.title: CUT
programme.desc: Bunny is attempting to rebuild her life in Atlanta. Her financial aid suddenly falls through, until she meets Renee who shows her the ways of hustling and fast money, as well as Ed, a music producer and drug addict. Will her bad choices and mistake take her down the wrong path?

programme.title: Blowback
programme.desc: Former Navy SEAL Ares Sterling, a family man with a dark past, lives peacefully until his wife Lisa is kidnapped after a home invasion. Desperate, Ares seeks help from his estranged father, King, a crime boss he blames for his tragic childhood. Ares revisits the shadows of his past, becoming ruthless to save Lisa and protect his daughter from similar loss, uncovering shocking secrets along the way.

programme.title: Heart and Soul Food
programme.desc: Three sisters fight for their mom's approval, unaware that their mother is dealing with a struggle of her own.

programme.title: Looking in the Mirror
programme.desc: In life you have to play the hand you're dealt, and when faced with a lifetime of adversity, Roslyn Jones does just that. Based on a true story.

programme.title: Krooked Lines
programme.desc: It's a race against time in this fast moving suspense drama where the lines between cops, criminals, love, and loyalty intersect. Two friends, one motivated by the law, the other motivated by money, try to bring down a human trafficking ring, while dealing with the death of a lover, and revelation of an undercover affair. The bond must survive, even when there is no one to trust.

programme.title: Fatal Witness
programme.desc: As if the dangerous streets of the West side of Chicago were not crazy enough, now there's a serial killer on the loose. Anyone who steps in the way of the Jackson Strangler, ends up as the next victim. When a local club dancer ends up strangled to death and stabbed, the entire city believes it's the Jackson strangler, but only one person truly knows... an unexpected witness that caught it all.

programme.title: Sneaky Links
programme.desc: Tammy, a popular social media influencer, has a high libido, and loves a variety of men. When Tammy's frenemy, Megan, gets wind of Tammy's slutty ways, her engagement to Jewelz, a high profile professional athlete, is at stake.

programme.title: Through Treasure's Door

programme.title: Delusional
programme.desc: When their perfect plan for a robbery goes wrong, a botched home invasion turns into a hostage situation, for a couple of desperate young toughs.

programme.desc: Tyler seeks revenge on a college classmate who he believes stole his girlfriend, Enna. Tyler returns to their hometown, reenters his old classmates lives, and begins unleashing dark secrets regarding Marcus, Enna, and Marcus' wife Lisa.

programme.desc: Azia Steed is a lead homicide detective who handles a heavy caseload while juggling her personal life. After taking some time off, she runs into an old fling, Dr. Ezrah Jacobs III. While he was away on a mission, his wife, a scientist on top-secret projects at the US National Laboratories, was killed in an explosion. He receives a new assignment to kill five people who have been designated as threats to national security.

programme.desc: The film chronicles the ups and downs of a Hollywood actress/comedian as she struggles to make it in Tinsel Town. programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Danilo toma a Mónica como rehén, y ella le confiesa que está embarazada para ganar tiempo. En cuanto él se distrae, ella lo mata. Con rabia, Aurelio amenaza al Chema por teléfono.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Chema hace que Rutila grabe un video como prueba de vida para Aurelio, ya que quiere hacer negocios. Andrew obtiene material donde el general Garnica aparece con drogas, con el que pretende chantajearlo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Leonor le dice a Ignacio que descubrió su esconditre de armas, y quiere saber si él pertenece al Escuadrón de la Muerte. El Chema y Aurelio se encuentran cara a cara en Villa Catalina.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio negocia con el Chema la libertad de Rutila, pero antes deben repartirse los territorios para evitar una guerra. Andrew presiona a Lay: quiere saber sobre sus vínculos con los Casillas.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Rutila seduce al Chema, y logra que él le de su número de teléfono; finalmente, él la entrega a Aurelio. Leonor le confiesa a Victoria que Ignacio trabaja para el Escuadrón de la Muerte.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Elsa entrega a Victoria y Leonor la grabación que incrimina al general Garnica. Leonor la sigue y la encuentra en Villa Catalina. Aurelio, despechado, manda a matar a Santiago.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Despechado, Aurelio envía a sus hombres a asesinar a Santiago, pero el atentado se complica cuando Ximena resulta baleada. El Chema averigua que Lay se fue a Colombia, y ordena que la maten.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Ximena acusa a Aurelio de haber mandado a matar a Santiago, y él le ruega no decirle nada a sus hijas. Rutila la ve morir y le dice a su padre que lo hará pagar por esa muerte.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: La tormentosa relación de Mónica y Aurelio se quiebra: él le confiesa que sus hombres mataron accidentalmente a Ximena, y que nunca dejó de amarla. Victoria ordena allanar el rancho de Danilo.

programme.desc: Victoria se horroriza cuando descubre que Danilo Ferro es en realidad Aurelio Casillas. Chacorta alerta a su hermano de abandonar el funeral de Ximena, porque los de la Marina vienen por ellos.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio captura al Turco y lo tortura para descubrir dónde está el dinero que le robó. Mientras, el Chema Venegas, desconfiando de los Casillas, ordena a Tijeras secuestrar a doña Alba.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Después de un tiroteo, Chacorta y sus hombres rescatan a doña Alba. El Chema se obsesiona con conocer la verdad sobre la muerte de Aurelio, y pide la lista de doctores que lo operaron.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Chema les ofrece refugio al Turco y la familia de Aurelio en una de sus casas de Los Ángeles para tenderles una trampa. Mónica tiene que matar al cocinero para poder escapar.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Mónica vuelve a casa y se encuentra con noticias impactantes. Tras una llamada de su hija Rutila, Aurelio recorre Los Ángeles en busca del Turco y su familia.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Ximena confiesa que no ama al Turco, que solo sintió agradecimiento por él. Después de matar a Ronnie, Aurelio encuentra a su exesposa, quien le dice que nunca volverá con él.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Luego de separarse tras el tiroteo, Aurelio y Ximena se reúnen con sus hijos. El Turco usa a Irina para averiguar el paradero de Casillas, y así poder negociar con él.

programme.desc: Aurelio visita a Mónica para amenazarla, pero ella recuerda el daño que él le hizo y se defiende. Más tarde, los hombres de Leonor se enfrentan a Chacorta y a Heriberto en una emboscada.

programme.title: Dos meseros majaderos

programme.title: Claudia y el Deseo
programme.desc: Una mujer se enamora de un hombre que sólo la desea como amante, y en su desesperación se casa con otro.

programme.desc: Una novicia come unos hongos especiales y cambia de personalidad actuando como una alocada joven sicodélica.

programme.title: Una carta de amor
programme.desc: Cuando va a ser fusilado, un militar lleva en su bolsillo una carta de amor de una joven que una vez lo ayudó a escapar.

programme.title: Lo que le pasó a Sansón
programme.desc: Un relato sobre Sansón y cómo escogió a la mujer equivocada por esposa rechazando a la hermosa Dalila.

programme.title: Ya sé quién eres
programme.desc: Una desubicada joven capitalina vive diversas peripecias.

programme.title: Entre Abogados te Veas
programme.desc: La esposa del arquitecto Mendoza se niega a darle el divorcio. Él está a punto de casarse de nueva cuenta con una socialité jalisciense y acude al licenciado Barrios, un sinvergüenza sin escrúpulos para quitarse de encima a su ex esposa.

programme.title: Por la puerta falsa
programme.desc: Un hombre tiene en su poder la hipoteca de la hacienda de sus antiguos patrones y quiere casarse con la hija de ellos por la fuerza.

programme.title: Capulina vs Las Momias

programme.desc: Un hombre vende revistas y al hacer una entrega es secuestrado por el dueño de una lúgubre mansión donde hay monstruos.

programme.title: El enamorado
programme.desc: Martín, ya retirado de su oficio de héroe debido a su matrimonio con Rosario, debe volver a las andanzas para ayudar a una amiga de unos asaltantes.

programme.title: La hermana Trinquete
programme.desc: Elena es una escurridiza ladrona y artista del disfraz. Al verse perseguida por la policía, se disfraza de monja y se refugia en un convento, donde seguirá cometiendo imprudencias.

programme.title: Departamento de Soltero
programme.desc: Un médico traspasa su departamento de soltero a su amigo, engaña a su novia haciéndose pasar por él y se casa con otra.

programme.title: Alguien nos quiere matar

programme.title: Solo para ti
programme.desc: Una joven consulta a un psicólogo para vencer su timidez, y se enamora de tres galanes pero no sabe por cual decidirse.

programme.title: Educando a papá
programme.desc: Un parrandero descubre que su hijo es un médico y hace todo para conseguir su perdón por haber abandonado a su madre.

programme.title: Fíjate qué suave
programme.desc: Un hombre y su abogado quieren casarse con dos jóvenes porque saben que pronto su madrina las convertirá en herederas.

programme.title: Las Mil y Una Noches

programme.title: Don Juan 67

programme.title: Tú y las Nubes

programme.title: Sor Tequila

programme.title: Los Hijos de María Morales
programme.desc: Las travesuras de dos alegres hermanos parranderos, cantadores, jugadores y sólo dominados por su severa madre.

programme.desc: Amid conflicts between the Cherokee tribe and Oklahoma's white settlers, the tribe's chief, Buffalo Horn (Ted de Corsia), is framed for murder. District Attorney Temple Houston (Bill Williams) must put aside his friendship with the chief and budding romance with the chief's daughter, Ruth Red Hawk (Gloria Talbott), to prosecute the case. Although Buffalo Horn has a solid alibi for the time of the killing, the political and business corruption of the territory makes a fair trial difficult.

programme.title: Law of the Lawless
programme.desc: A gunfighter-turned-judge faces trouble from an old friend after he sentences the man's son to death.

programme.title: Gunfight at the O.K. Corral
programme.desc: Lawman Wyatt Earp (Burt Lancaster) and gunfighter John "Doc" Holliday (Kirk Douglas) find themselves together again in Tombstone, Ariz., despite the tumultuous history between them. Earp comes to Arizona on a mission to bring the Clayton clan to justice. Meanwhile, Holliday becomes incensed with the decision of Kate Fisher (Jo Van Fleet) to turn him down in favor of another gunfighter (John Ireland), ultimately leading Holliday to join Earp's side in a confrontation with the Claytons.

programme.title: Posse
programme.desc: Texas Marshal Howard Nightingale (Kirk Douglas) aspires to become a U.S. senator and believes that to do so, he must capture the gunslinger Jack Strawhorn (Bruce Dern). Recognizing a dangerous foe, Nightingale gathers a posse of ruthless law enforcers to track him down. His triumph seems imminent after the posse apprehends the outlaw's gang, though Strawhorn himself escapes. Nightingale's confidence is shaken, however, when arresting the elusive bandit proves politically complicated.

programme.title: Last Train From Gun Hill
programme.desc: As the wealthiest and most powerful man in the Wild West town of Gun Hill, cattle rancher Craig Belden (Anthony Quinn) has come to believe he's above the law. When his son, Rick (Earl Holliman), rapes and murders a Native American woman (Ziva Rodann) married to U.S. marshal Matt Morgan (Kirk Douglas), Belden arrogantly declines to allow his son's arrest. The marshal, once a friend of Belden's, takes on the rancher's henchmen and Rick's accomplice (Brian Hutton) to bring the killer to justice.

No longer content to toil for the rich and powerful, Roman plans to bring a new order to Mexico by force with his small ragtag group. While Roman and Kowalski are outnumbered facing the Mexican army, they also have to contend with Curly (Jack Palance), a vengeful killer out for blood.

programme.desc: A rancher is shot by an unknown killer, and his daughter's lover is jailed.

programme.title: The Gene Autry Show
programme.desc: Gene welcomes a girl to his ranch for underprivileged boys; crooks try to take over the ranch.

programme.title: How the West Was Won
programme.desc: Setting off on a journey to the west in the 1830s, the Prescott family run into a man named Linus (James Stewart), who helps them fight off a pack of thieves. Linus then marries daughter Eve Prescott (Carroll Baker), and 30 years later goes off to fight in the Civil War with their son, with bloody results. Eve's sister, Lily (Debbie Reynolds), heads further west and has adventures with a professional gambler (Gregory Peck), stretching all the way to San Francisco and into the 1880s.

programme.title: Escape From Fort Bravo
programme.desc: Captain Roper (William Holden) is the warden of a Union-run prison camp. A mysterious woman named Carla Forester (Eleanor Parker) arrives at the camp in order to free the Confederate prisoners, and things get complicated when Carla and the captain begin to fall for each other. In an effort to recapture the escaped prisoners, Roper has a run-in with a group of Mescalero Indians. In order to survive, he has to team up with his own prisoners to fight the Indians and wipe them out.

programme.title: Wild Rovers
programme.desc: Tired of his job at a ranch owned by Walter Buckman (Karl Malden), Frank Post (Ryan O'Neal) wants to pull a heist, and when his much older coworker, Ross Bodine (William Holden), sees nothing better on the horizon, the cowboys agree to team up for the crime. After filling their pockets with loot from a local bank, Frank and Ross ride toward what they hope is freedom. But the younger Buckmans, Paul (Joe Don Baker) and John (Tom Skerritt), pursue them over the rough land of the Southwest.

programme.title: The Long Riders
programme.desc: During a bank robbery by the legendary James-Younger Gang, Ed Miller (Dennis Quaid) impulsively kills a man, much to the displeasure of leader Jesse James (James Keach), who insists that the gang scatter until the heat is off. The groups of brothers go their separate ways, with Cole Younger (David Carradine) considering settling down with his feisty girlfriend, Belle Starr (Pamela Reed). But they soon regroup for an ill-fated bank job in Northfield, Minn., that results in an epic chase.

programme.title: Tom Horn
programme.desc: A renowned gunslinger with a storied past, Tom Horn (Steve McQueen) opts for a reclusive life until he starts working for rancher John Coble (Richard Farnsworth). Though Horn begins seeing pretty local teacher Glendolene Kimmel (Linda Evans), he remains restless. Investigating livestock theft, Horn is brutal when dealing with criminals, and while his presence is initially appreciated, eventually the community grows concerned about the enforcer's violent methods.

programme.title: Cabela's Deer Gear TV
programme.desc: Advancements in crossbows continue to be important within the hunting industry. In this episode, Randy Wood, from TenPoint Crossbows, walks us through all of the latest advancements that their team has created for the upcoming deer season.

programme.title: Just Kill'n Time TV
programme.desc: 17 youth episodes and counting. Let's watch the youngsters get it done!

programme.title: Slock Master
programme.desc: The Slock Master reveals the tricks and tips that fool predators. Bowhunting coyotes, fox, lion, bobcat and more with incredible close up call ins and amazing archery action. Watch the world's top bow hunter slock em on The Slock Master.

programme.title: Modern Hunter
programme.desc: Noah Rucks heads to the rolling hills of Kentucky with hopes high and tags in his pocket. Chasing whitetails through both the early archery season and the later muzzleloader hunt, Noah experiences firsthand how unpredictable and humbling is.

programme.title: Maxed Outdoors
programme.desc: Max and his crew heads down to Florida in hopes of getting an Osceola turkey. Things don't all go as planned during Max's hunt; however, he and his guide, Jon, are still able to get it done.

programme.title: Deer and Deer Hunting
programme.desc: With bucks on their feet and chasing does, Dan puts his skills and his muzzleloader to the test, hoping to connect with a true Sooner State giant.

programme.title: The Next Bite
programme.desc: Chase Parsons and Dylan Peotter use forward facing sonar and glide baits to catch deep inland Lake Trout.
programme.sub-title: Inland Lakers: Forward Facing Sonar in Deep Water

programme.title: University of Fishing
programme.desc: Elite series pro Bryan New joins us to use weird looking baits to catch giant smallmouth in Wisconsin.
programme.sub-title: Weird baits that catch big smallmouth

programme.title: Fly Rod Chronicles
programme.desc: Last week on Fly Rod Chronicles we traveled to the world-renowned Casa Vieja Lodge in Guatemala to catch sailfish on the fly. Captain/Owner David Salazar and his crew put us on so many sailfish we couldn't fit it all into one show so stick around.
programme.sub-title: Sailfish On The Fly In Guatemala Pt. 2

programme.title: Seasons on the Fly
programme.desc: Traveling to Belize to pursue the myriad fish swimming in its shallow flats; an adventure off the coast of Placencia to chase bonefish, permit and snook.

programme.title: The High Road With Keith Warren
programme.desc: It's time for some good old High Road PEST CONTROL! Keith is grabbing a couple of his favorite high-power air guns and heading on down to Miami to help take care of their iguana problem. It's time to kick some prehistoric Miami Monster tail!

programme.title: Wiebe Trapline Adventures
programme.desc: Our day continues as we catch up with John Houben, government trapper, wildlife biologist and district supervisor in the Federal Wildlife Services Program. Just when you think it can't get more exciting, stay with us and finish the day.
programme.sub-title: John and Mark on Multi Line 2 of 2

programme.title: Innerloc's Outthere Stories
programme.desc: Brody and his dad travel to Indiana for an archery deer hunt. The Bear Archery Gear is ready to Rule The Woods.

programme.title: Shoot Straight TV
programme.desc: This week Marsha is heading to Iowa in pursuit of whitetails with her muzzleloader. She is using a new model from CVA and the deer are hitting the late season food sources. She will have a delicious recipe from the field and Chad.

programme.title: McWhorters Precision Hunting
programme.desc: Seth heads to South Texas to hunt big whitetails with good friends Dallas and Lance at the G4 Ranch.
programme.sub-title: South Texas Whitetails at the G4 Ranch

programme.title: Deertopia
programme.desc: Steve shares expert tips on enhancing your hunting property by identifying and providing resources deer may lack in the surrounding area. From food and water to bedding and security, learn how to attract and hold more deer by meeting their needs.

programme.title: Carnivore
programme.desc: Ultrasonics echo across the South Texas brush country as the FREQ, the world's only ultrasonic caller lures Coyotes and even something totally unexpected.

programme.title: Hunting After Dark
programme.desc: Texas gets a cold snap. What are the varmints and pigs going to do in this freak winter storm!

programme.title: Dean Partridge's Canadian Whitetail
programme.desc: Part two of Rochelles Multi-year hunt with her Excalibur crossbow for the Flyer buck.

programme.title: Live the Wild Life
programme.desc: Follow Gus to Ohio and see some of the best whitetails the Buckeye State has to offer.

programme.title: Hard Truths Of Conservation
programme.desc: With the fall of the Soviet Union, wildlife populations in Tajikistan were devastated, bringing some of their unique mountain species to the brink of extinction.

programme.title: The Bassquatch Hunter: Fish Out of Water
programme.desc: Kayak Fishing vs. Pro Golf Mike takes LPGA legend- Vicky Hurst out fishing where she picked up casting and catching very quickly! Mike did not do as well on the golf course, but a lot of laughs and a whole lot of swings ensued!

programme.title: Wallhanger Tv
programme.desc: After a quick recap and road trip home, Cadyn and Chad return south for a hot-weather bow hunt in Alabama, where Cadyn proves the grind pays off with her biggest Bama buck to date.

programme.title: Weird Hunts
programme.desc: Using a decoy on his bow, Matt is trying to inch close to a mature bull. He makes some cosmetic changes to his decoy to add antlers and coax one in to shooting range.

programme.title: The American Way
programme.desc: Angie Walker hunts Indiana Whitetail.

programme.title: Conquest 200 - Life on a Family Deer Farm
programme.desc: Step behind the scenes of a working whitetail deer farm to discover the real story behind hunting scents. In Farm Chores, Doug Roberts of Conquest Scents reveals the surprising truth about deer urine collection-how it's regulated.

programme.title: Surviving Mann
programme.desc: The fifth episode of Wild Shots Season 1 is here!

programme.title: Maxed Outdoors
programme.desc: Max and his crew heads down to Florida in hopes of getting an Osceola turkey. Things don't all go as planned during Max's hunt; however, he and his guide, Jon, are still able to get it done.

programme.title: Yamaha's Whitetail Diaries
programme.desc: The holidays are always a fun time to be at the Whitetail Diaries deer camp and this year is no exception as the Nessl and Newby Boys come visit with their dads right after Christmas.

programme.title: For Love Or Likes
programme.desc: Sadie Bass lays her hands on a giant buck to take the lead, but another contestant arrows a giant to bring herself back into contention. A wild challenge takes place that puts the girls shooting skills and speed to the test.

programme.title: The Edge
programme.desc: Host Joe Eppele joins Nick McCabe from River Monster Adventures for catch and release sturgeon fishing along the Fraser River in scenic Lillooet BC.
programme.sub-title: Fraser River Sturgeon - The Legend of Pig Nose

programme.title: Doug Koenig's Championship Season
programme.desc: Join Shooting Pro Doug Koenig as he travels to Spain with his son Trevor in the pursuit of Spanish Ibex. Doug is on his pursuit for a Beceite Ibex while Trevor is going for his first Gredos Ibex. Both are using the Ruger Hawkeye chambered in 6.5 PRC.

programme.title: On The Road
programme.desc: It's turkey season in Wisconsin, and Steve, Papa Glenn, and Craig Morgan join their good friend Chuck Paddock for an exciting hunt. The team is eager to chase some gobblers and share their hunting adventures.

programme.title: Pursue The Wild
programme.desc: Kristy Titus opens the gates to her Wyoming home range to welcome three women from Girls with Guns Clothing for a week of learning, laughter, and rifle training. Together, they dive into the fundamentals-mounting optics, zeroing rifles, and traject.
programme.sub-title: Home Range: Strong Women, Wild Hunts

programme.title: Target Rich Environment
programme.desc: The TRE crew drags the famous couch back to the field for dove season-this time, it's our turn to pull the trigger instead of guiding. When the barrels get hot the dove don't stand a chance. And when the sky fills with pigeons.

programme.title: Red Arrow Tv
programme.desc: This week, Kip is trying to take out a big ram after the guys spot hundreds of aoudad while Terry is trying to take down a buffalo (without getting straight up mauled by a cougar). Then some camels show up….Anyway….just watch the show.

programme.title: Saltwater Underground With Nick Honachefsky
programme.desc: Yellowfin tuna are firing offshore New Jersey; Nick puts together a brand-new tuna crew with NYPD cop bodybuilder influencer Mike Counihan to join Capt. JR Licato on the Hookin Up Sportfishing for battles with yellowfin pushing the 80-pound mark.

programme.title: George Poveromo's World of Saltwater Fishing
programme.desc: George Poveromo invites YouTube personalities Clay and Stephanie Cowart to join him for some fishing off Key Largo, Florida Keys.
programme.sub-title: BROADCAST MEETS YOUTUBE, Key Largo, Florida Keys!

programme.title: Sportsman's Adventures With Captain Rick Murphy
programme.desc: Capt. Rick invites bass pro Mike Iaconelli to fish for snook, trout and redfish in Goodland, Fla., with Capt. Ron Hueston at the helm.

programme.title: Chasin The Sun
programme.desc: With Meredith McCord halfway around the world, Capt. Justin Leake gives show producer Chris Hermans his first shot at landing a tarpon after filming them for 9 seasons. Does art imitate life?

programme.title: Goliath Fishing
programme.desc: Join James as he embarks on an adventure through Argentina, a land teeming with exotic wildlife and breathtaking landscapes. In this episode, James sets out to catch the elusive fish he's only seen in magazines.

programme.title: Uncharted Waters with Peter Miller
programme.desc: Peter takes his good Friend and Super Bowl Champ, Chris Jones from the Kansas City Chiefs fishing. Chris was hoping for Sailfish and Tuna with only a 4 hour window to fish. He was coming from training camp and only had a limited time to fish.
programme.sub-title: Peter Miller takes Chris Jones, 2 Time Super Bowl Champion, Fishing for Tuna, Sailfish and Shark.

programme.title: The Bassquatch Hunter: Fish Out of Water
programme.desc: Kayak Fishing vs. Pro Golf Mike takes LPGA legend- Vicky Hurst out fishing where she picked up casting and catching very quickly! Mike did not do as well on the golf course, but a lot of laughs and a whole lot of swings ensued!

programme.title: Carolina All Out
programme.desc: A ground breaking research project is coming to the Sounds of North Carolina! Chad Thomas of the North Carolina Marine & Estuary Foundation is standing by as we hook bull reds and bring them to the boat to fit with satellite tags that will help us.

programme.title: Fly Rod Chronicles
programme.desc: Last week on Fly Rod Chronicles we traveled to the world-renowned Casa Vieja Lodge in Guatemala to catch sailfish on the fly. Captain/Owner David Salazar and his crew put us on so many sailfish we couldn't fit it all into one show so stick around.
programme.sub-title: Sailfish On The Fly In Guatemala Pt. 2

programme.title: Lindner's Angling Edge
programme.desc: When wind is a variable, deploying the best boat control and lure selection are critical. Watch Al Lindner and Ty Sjodin battle windy conditions to catch big crappies.

programme.title: Skeeter Bass Champs
programme.desc: This is Stop #4 of the Skeeter Bass Champs Team Tournaments on the Cedar Creek, as we follow a couple of great teams battling it out!

programme.title: Fishing And Hunting Texas
programme.desc: Texas offers a wide range of hunting opportunities and you'll see a great mix in this episode where we'll hunt in Southwest Texas for Aoudad, Turkeys and whitetail does.

programme.title: Bass Pro Shop's Fisherman's Handbook
programme.desc: Anglers are constantly on the search for information to help them be more successful on the water. In this episode of the Bass Pro Shops Fisherman's Handbook, top pro anglers and industry professionals are here to offer educational information.

programme.title: Deer and Deer Hunting
programme.desc: With bucks on their feet and chasing does, Dan puts his skills and his muzzleloader to the test, hoping to connect with a true Sooner State giant.

programme.title: Hard Truths of Conservation
programme.desc: Dan Cabela is joining a team of veterinarians and biologists on an ambitious capture operation to test and monitor bighorn sheep in Nevada; he hopes to understand better how the hunting community helps fund population recoveries.

programme.title: Operation Healing Heroes
programme.desc: Retired Colonel Paul Wharton shares his memories of leading his soldiers while teaching his own children the philosophy of mission, men and me.

programme.title: Fisherman's Digest
programme.desc: John Bergsma showcases fishing hot spots in the Great Lakes region.

programme.title: Destination Dive
programme.desc: Key West is known for bars, nightlife and history, but its underwater world can be just as lively; visiting beautiful, resilient coral reefs and the crown jewel of the Keys: the USS Vandenburg shipwreck.

programme.title: Adventure Cities
programme.desc: Seasoned travel writer Jonathan Thompson sets out to explore the adventurous sides of Dallas, Texas, and Pensacola, Fla.

programme.title: Parks of the Palm Beaches
programme.desc: EXTREME SPORTS IN THE PALM BEACHES AT THE WORLD'S ONLY HYDRO DRAG RACES, EXPERIENCE MOUNTAIN BIKING FOR ALL AGES AND CUT LOOSE AT OKEEHEELEE BMX IN PALM BEACH COUNTY, FLORIDA.

programme.title: Motorhead Garage
programme.desc: Dave checks out creative and innovative upfitting solutions for trucks and vans that'll change the way you work, and John gives a lesson in line pressure and transmission service.

programme.desc: The key historical forces that characterize the Gilded Age and the Progressive Era; the competing ideals that define these eras; the US in 1865; the extraordinary social, political and economic changes unleashed by the devastation of the Civil War.

programme.title: America in the Gilded Age and Progressive Era
programme.desc: The Reconstruction era following the Civil War; governmental policies and legislation enacted to safeguard the welfare of former slaves and average citizens; these policies are progressively dismantled, the South comes under the rule of the whites.

programme.title: Conquest of the Americas
programme.desc: Neither the Eurocentric term 'discovery' nor the blandly neutral 'encounters' do justice to the impact of Europeans, Africans and Native Americans coming together in the New World; a collision whose causes and effects are outlined in this lecture.

programme.title: Conquest of the Americas
programme.desc: Most of the inhabitants of the Americas arrive in migratory waves from Asia between 40,000 and 2,000 B.C.; their civilizations are based on sophisticated irrigation and farming; complex religions and social structures; rivaling those of Europe.

programme.title: Introduction to Paleontology
programme.desc: Taking a virtual walk from the Washington Monument to the U.S. Capitol to explore the 4.54 billion-year history of Earth, with each stride representing 1 to 2 million years; along the way, fossils paint a picture of life on Earth from its start.

programme.title: Introduction to Paleontology
programme.desc: Learning about those whose curiosity about the Earth and its fossils leads to the development of the science of paleontology; studying the geographic, climatic and chemical requirements for a living organism to leave behind its fossilized record.

programme.title: Cities of the Ancient World
programme.desc: Cities are integral to modern lives; why wandering ancient humans leave the forests and plains to create settlements; the fundamental question of "why" is the first step toward understanding the inhabitants and lessons from ancient cities.

programme.title: Cities of the Ancient World
programme.desc: Imagining a city with no streets, public buildings or common spaces; the world's first city offers an intriguing window into life in the Neolithic era; exploring the remains of Catalhoyuk's family housing, murals and religious shrines.
programme.sub-title: Çatalhöyük - First Experiment in Urban Living

programme.title: The Darwinian Revolution
programme.desc: Pondering why Darwin is so revolutionary; his breakthrough is not in introducing the idea of evolution, which has long been debated, but in proposing how evolution occurs; surveying these and other themes that are developed in the course.

programme.title: The Darwinian Revolution
programme.desc: Examining the traditional worldview in the West, which is based on the biblical account of creation fixed at 4004 B.C.; an allied idea is the Great Chain of Being, pictured as an immutable scale of life forms from the most primitive to God himself.
programme.sub-title: The Way It Used to Be

programme.title: An Economic History of the World Since 1400
programme.desc: Differences between economic history and a history of economics; the primary concerns of current economic historians; watershed economic moments of the last 500 years; why modern economic history begins around 1400.

programme.title: An Economic History of the World Since 1400
programme.desc: Examining the state of the global economy circa 1400, when Europe was at the bottom of the economic success ladder; the broad economic outlines of China, India, and the Islamic world; how Europe laid groundwork for the new capitalist world system.
programme.sub-title: Marco Polo, China, and the Silk Road Trade

programme.title: America After the Cold War: The First 30 Years
programme.desc: The end of the Cold War is a key point in history; the rapid collapse of the Soviet Union; the fall of the Berlin Wall; delving into the American story in the early 1990s; conflicts in Kuwait and Bosnia test America's new role in a post-Soviet world.

programme.title: America After the Cold War: The First 30 Years
programme.desc: Bill Clinton's presidency dominates the domestic news in the 1990s. From his dramatic showdown with Newt Gingrich and the Republican Congress's Contract with America, this is a presidency of high drama; surveying the tumultuous decade.

programme.title: Pompeii: Daily Life in An Ancient Roman City
programme.desc: When most people hear the name of the archeological site of Pompeii, they think of destruction; gaining an overview of the course; considering why the remains of Pompeii offer more than just a story of a cataclysm.

programme.title: Pompeii: Daily Life in An Ancient Roman City
programme.desc: Land and humankind help to shape Pompeii; examining the violent geological forces that forge the distinctive region of the Bay of Naples; tracing its influence on the surrounding geography; the various cultures that contribute to life in this area.
programme.sub-title: Geology and Geography On the Bay of Naples

programme.title: America in the Gilded Age and Progressive Era
programme.desc: The Reconstruction era following the Civil War; governmental policies and legislation enacted to safeguard the welfare of former slaves and average citizens; these policies are progressively dismantled, the South comes under the rule of the whites.

programme.title: The Holy Land Revealed
programme.desc: What is meant by "holy land"; the difference between archeology and history; how reliable the Hebrew Bible is as a window into life in ancient Israel; answers to these and other questions; the region's earliest recorded inhabitants, the Canaanites.

programme.title: The Holy Land Revealed
programme.desc: What archeologists uncover about the arrival of the Israelites into Canaan; an ancient Egyptian stele with the earliest reference to Israel; the remains of Jericho's walls; a Philistine temple similar to the one Samson destroys in the book of Judges.

programme.title: The Holy Land Revealed
programme.desc: Surveying the topography and layout of Jerusalem; reviewing biblical accounts of Jerusalem from the arrival of David around 1,000 B.C.E. to the start of the Babylonian exile in 586 B.C.E.; the remains of an Assyrian siege on the city of Lachish.
programme.sub-title: Jerusalem - An Introduction to the City

programme.title: The Holy Land Revealed
programme.desc: A first look at the biblical City of David; combing through the remains of a scribe's house behind a city wall; the development of biblical Hebrew script; rare examples of this script in a clay sealing, a piece of pottery and a victory stele.
programme.sub-title: The Jerusalem of David and Solomon

programme.title: The Holy Land Revealed
programme.desc: The City of David's ancient water system centered on the Gihon Spring; the three different water systems that are created due to the spring's location outside the city walls; these include Warren's Shaft, Siloam Channel and Hezekiah's Tunnel.

programme.title: The Holy Land Revealed
programme.desc: Learning about Israel as it is ruled under the Omride dynasty between Solomon's death and the Assyrian invasion in 722 B.C.E.; exploring ruins such as the High Place at Dan; the acropolis at Samaria, which holds the remains of King Ahab's palace.
programme.sub-title: Samaria and the Northern Kingdom of Israel

programme.title: The Catholic Church: A History
programme.desc: In the early days of the Christian faith, there is no church; no single institution to guide the followers of Jesus; stepping into the world of the early church; the roots of Christianity as found in ancient Jewish traditions and the gospel.
programme.sub-title: From Jesus to the Creation of the Church

programme.title: The Catholic Church: A History
programme.desc: In the first century A.D., the followers of Christ evolve from a band of disciples into tight-knit communities of worship; a glimpse of these communities in some of the earliest Christian documents; the Acts of the Apostles and the letters of Paul.

programme.title: The Catholic Church: A History
programme.desc: Christianity quickly spreads all over the Mediterranean region in the first few centuries; learning how believers adapt the practice of their faith to create a great diversity of worship in the early church.

programme.title: The Catholic Church: A History
programme.desc: The Christian church catches the attention of the Roman emperor; he views the faithful as a threat to imperial authority and Roman culture; the widespread persecution of Christians that follows; a new class of Christian heroes, the martyred saints.

programme.title: The Catholic Church: A History
programme.desc: In 312 A.D., Christianity gains a powerful ally when the Roman emperor Constantine adopts the faith of Jesus as his own; seeing how this shift affects Christian believers; the church goes from being a persecuted minority to a privileged minority.

programme.title: The World of Biblical Israel
programme.desc: Entering the world of biblical Israel with a historical overview; an examination of how the Bible gives insights into the daily life of ancient Israelites; considering the context for how the Bible comes into being.
programme.sub-title: Biblical Israel - The Story of a People

programme.title: The World of Biblical Israel
programme.desc: A look at the Babylonian exile; the exiled Judeans begin asking themselves who they are as a people and why they are conquered; as the Bible begins to be compiled in this time of exile, it offers two vantage points for understanding its history.
programme.sub-title: By the Rivers of Babylon - Exile

programme.title: The World of Biblical Israel
programme.desc: Surveying the stories of ancient Israel's origins as preserved in the book of Genesis; these origin stories are crucial for understanding the books that follow because ancient Israel understands itself to be a family that descends from Jacob.

programme.title: The World of Biblical Israel
programme.desc: A look at Moses; the story of the Israelites' exodus from Egypt; tracing the narrative of Moses's journey, which includes receiving the Ten Commandments from Yahweh; reviewing the Torah, the "law of Moses"; the origins of the priesthood.

programme.title: The World of Biblical Israel
programme.desc: The emergence of Israel as a nation, which is detailed in the books of Joshua and Judges; what the books say about the Israelites' conquest of Canaan; what archeological evidence shows about this period; biblical archeology's origins and methods.

programme.title: World War I: The "Great War"
programme.desc: The opening lecture presents the main themes of the course; beginning with the concept of total war; other themes include the role of ideology, the meanings ascribed to the war by different sides and the war's legacy.

programme.title: World War I: The "Great War"
programme.desc: Examining the state of Europe and the world before the onset of the war in 1914; the emergence of the German Empire creates strains in the international balance of power; divided among Great Britain, France, Germany, Austria-Hungary and Russia.

programme.title: World War I: The "Great War"
programme.desc: Even among those who expect war, there are widespread misconceptions about the nature of the conflict to come; in this lecture, exploring the prevailing ideas and attitudes in Europe; the premonitions noted by contemporaries of coming disaster.
programme.sub-title: Towards Crisis in Politics and Culture

programme.title: World War I: The "Great War"
programme.desc: This lecture analyzes the immediate events that lead to war; the assassination of Archduke Franz Ferdinand of Austria-Hungary at Sarajevo in June 1914; the diplomatic chain reactions that follow in the July Crisis.
programme.sub-title: Causes of the War and the July Crisis, 1914

programme.title: World War I: The "Great War"
programme.desc: The hysterical celebration known as the August Madness greets the outbreak of war between the Central Powers (Germany and Austria-Hungary) and the Allies (France, Great Britain and Russia); how widespread this emotional outburst really is.

programme.title: World War I: The "Great War"
programme.desc: This lecture follows the unfolding of the German Schlieffen Plan, which envisions quick victory on two fronts; the French Plan XVII aims to recover lost French territories; both attempts are thwarted.
programme.sub-title: The Failed Gambles - War Plans Break Down

programme.title: Change of Habit
programme.desc: Dr. John Carpenter (Elvis Presley) takes the job of running a health center in a low-income district. He enlists three women to help out who -- unbeknownst to him -- are actually nuns in street clothes. The church wants to improve the neighborhood but fears that nuns in full habit would not be well received. Unaware of her unavailability, John falls for Sister Michelle (Mary Tyler Moore), serenading her with his guitar -- which, luckily for him, effectively wears away at her religious resolve.

programme.title: The Electric Horseman
programme.desc: A former champion rodeo rider is reduced to using his saddle skills to promote a breakfast cereal in a gaudy Las Vegas show. When he's asked to perform with a $12 million horse that he discovers is being doped to remain docile, he flees into the desert astride the beast in an act of defiance. A story-hungry female reporter gives chase.

programme.title: Out of Africa
programme.desc: Initially set on being a dairy farmer, the aristocratic Karen Blixen (Meryl Streep) travels to Africa to join her husband, Bror (Klaus Maria Brandauer), who instead spends their money on a coffee plantation. After discovering Bror is unfaithful, Karen develops feelings for hunter Denys (Robert Redford), but realizes he prefers a simplistic lifestyle compared to her upper class background. The two continue on until a series of events force Karen to choose between her love and personal growth.

programme.title: Legal Eagles
programme.desc: Chelsea Deardon (Daryl Hannah) is arrested for stealing artwork painted by her deceased father, and sympathetic attorney Laura Kelly (Debra Winger) sets out to defend the young woman against slick prosecutor Tom Logan (Robert Redford). After a series of romantic exchanges, Tom ends up falling in love with Laura and teaming up with her to help clear Chelsea of the charges. However, as they lawyers dig deeper into the case, things take a shocking turn, and Tom finds his career in jeopardy.

programme.title: Heroes
programme.desc: A troubled Vietnam veteran (Henry Winkler) with plans for a worm farm meets a girl (Sally Field) and hops a bus to California.

programme.title: That Old Feeling
programme.desc: Molly De Mora (Paula Marshall) is getting married, with her beau being Keith Marks (Jamie Denton), a political hopeful who is running on a family values platform. Molly invites her now-divorced parents, Lilly (Bette Midler) and Dan (Dennis Farina), to the ceremony, only to see them rekindle their romance despite the fact both are remarried. Fearing a tabloid scandal that could damage Keith's candidacy, Molly sets out to stop them, but the pair have run off and aren't so easily tracked.

programme.title: Raggedy Man
programme.desc: While World War II rages overseas, a divorced mother of two, Nita Longley (Sissy Spacek), struggles to makes ends meet as a telephone operator in small-town Texas. As the subject of disdainful gossip due to her divorce, Nita faces a lonely existence of ostracism, where only the unscrupulous approach her -- often with ill intent. When she befriends Teddy (Eric Roberts), a sailor on leave, her situation improves, but he's soon sent to war. Once again, Nita must face her plight alone.

programme.title: Continental Divide
programme.desc: Chicago reporter Ernie Souchak (John Belushi) is beaten up by double-dealing police officers after he writes about an unethical city councilman. Hoping to keep Ernie safe, his editor, Howard McDermott (Allen Goorwitz), tells him to head west. In Wyoming, Ernie strikes up a romance with bird scientist Nell Porter (Blair Brown), but as soon as he goes home, he's drawn back into city politics. With Nell about to discuss her research in Chicago, this might be the couple's last chance to reunite.

programme.title: Bird on a Wire
programme.desc: Rick Jarmin (Mel Gibson) is put in witness protection after he helps the FBI bust drug dealer Eugene Sorenson (David Carradine). Fifteen years later, he is living with a new identity as a gas station attendant in Detroit. When an old flame named Marianne (Goldie Hawn) stops at the gas station and recognizes him, his cover gets blown. The recently released Sorenson finds out, and both Jarmin and Marianne have to flee across the country with the vengeful Sorenson in hot pursuit.

programme.title: Housesitter
programme.desc: Architect Newton Davis (Steve Martin) is distraught when his girlfriend, Becky (Dana Delany), spurns his proposal and refuses to move into the lavish house he designed for her. Davis, who cannot imagine himself living alone in the house, shares his tale of woe with Gwen (Goldie Hawn), a dishonest waitress he thinks doesn't speak English. Complications arise when Davis, on the brink of reconciliation with Becky, discovers that Gwen has moved into the couple's soon-to-be dream home.

programme.title: Heart and Souls
programme.desc: Harrison (Charles Grodin), Penny (Alfre Woodard), Julia (Kyra Sedgwick) and Milo (Tom Sizemore) die in 1959 when the bus they are riding crashes. The four continue as ghosts, guardians to the child born at the moment of their deaths. Baby Thomas grows up to be a businessman (Robert Downey Jr.) who has memories of his playmates, but assumes they are products of his youthful imagination. When the ghosts realize they need Thomas' help to move on, they decide to make an appearance once more.

programme.title: Cry Baby
programme.desc: A prim and proper schoolgirl goes against her mother's wishes when she dates a motorcycle-riding juvenile delinquent.

programme.title: The Cockeyed Cowboys of Calico County
programme.desc: In the Wild West, Charley (Dan Blocker), a blacksmith, is a nice man but not the smartest in his little town. And when his quest for a mail-order bride is fruitless, he's embarrassed and threatens to ditch. But since he's the only blacksmith around, the people decide to hatch a plan to keep Charley around. Eventually, they pay local saloon girl Sadie (Nanette Fabray) to pose as the missing bride. But complications ensue as Charley begins to fall in love with Sadie.

programme.title: Act of the Heart
programme.desc: Zealously devout Christian Martha (Geneviève Bujold) arrives in Montreal to assist widowed mother Johane (Monique Leyrac) with the care of her ailing young son, Russell (William Mitchell). Martha lives with a monastic simplicity, spending her free time singing with a church choir, despite being surrounded by wealthy people. Life becomes more interesting when she develops a crush on handsome priest Ferrier (Donald Sutherland) -- but a spiritual crisis pushes her to make a dangerous confession.

programme.title: Minnie and Moskowitz
programme.desc: Depressed and jaded after being dumped by her married boyfriend, aging beauty Minnie Moore (Gena Rowlands) wonders if she'll ever find love. After shaggy-haired parking lot attendant Seymour Moskowitz (Seymour Cassel) comes to her defense from an angry and rebuffed blind date, he falls hopelessly in love with her despite their myriad differences. Minnie reluctantly agrees to a date with Moskowitz, and, slowly but surely, an unlikely romance blossoms between the two.

programme.title: The Girl From Petrovka
programme.desc: A Moscow-based U.S. journalist (Hal Holbrook) falls in love with a ballerina (Goldie Hawn) being followed by the police.

programme.title: That Funny Feeling
programme.desc: A New York publisher (Bobby Darin) humors an actress/maid (Sandra Dee) who tries to pass off his apartment as her own.

programme.title: Same Time, Next Year
programme.desc: In 1951, at a small California inn, George (Alan Alda) and Doris (Ellen Burstyn) have an affair. Instead of writing it off as a one-night stand, the pair decide to meet at the inn every year for a romantic retreat, away from their respective spouses and families. In the decades that follow, both George and Doris face their own personal struggles and hardships, and together they develop a level of love and intimacy that exceeds the ones found in their own marriages.

programme.title: On Patrol: Live
programme.desc: "On Patrol: Live" follows police officers and sheriff's deputies from diverse agencies in different cities across the country for three hours. Program hosts Dan Abrams, Deputy Sheriff Curtis Wilson, and Captain Tom Rizzo provide minute-by-minute perspective and analysis from a central studio location during footage. Local residents from the communities of featured departments are given the opportunity to have a firsthand experience during ride-alongs with officers on live nights.

programme.title: Cops Reloaded
programme.desc: "Cops" has been producing new episodes for more than 20 years, and with daily repeats of the iconic series entering their second decade on the air, producers felt it was time for a change to freshen things up, which is how the idea for "Cops Reloaded" was born. This entry in the long-running franchise takes footage from previous episodes and re-edits it to produce new episodes. Some of the program's wildest criminals, most memorable car chases, and craziest moments are featured on "Reloaded."

programme.title: Jackie Brown
programme.desc: When flight attendant Jackie Brown (Pam Grier) is busted smuggling money for her arms dealer boss, Ordell Robbie (Samuel L. Jackson), agent Ray Nicolette (Michael Keaton) and detective Mark Dargus (Michael Bowen) want her help to bring down Robbie. Facing jail time for her silence or death for her cooperation, Brown decides instead to double-cross both parties and make off with the smuggled money. Meanwhile, she enlists the help of bondsman Max Cherry (Robert Forster), a man who loves her.

programme.title: If Beale Street Could Talk
programme.desc: In early 1970s Harlem, daughter and wife-to-be Tish vividly recalls the passion, respect and trust that have connected her and her artist fiancé Alonzo Hunt, who goes by the nickname Fonny. Friends since childhood, the devoted couple dream of a future together, but their plans are derailed when Fonny is arrested for a crime he did not commit.

programme.title: Precious: Based on the Novel "Push" by Sapphire
programme.desc: Pregnant by her own father for the second time, 16-year-old Claireece "Precious" Jones (Gabourey Sidibe) can neither read nor write and suffers constant abuse at the hands of her vicious mother (Mo'Nique). Precious instinctively sees a chance to turn her life around when she is offered the opportunity to transfer to an alternative school. Under the patient, firm guidance of her new teacher, Ms. Rain (Paula Patton), Precious begins the journey from oppression to self-determination.

programme.title: Eve's Bayou
programme.desc: Over the course of a long, hot Louisiana summer, a 10-year-old black girl, Eve Batiste (Jurnee Smollett), discovers that her family's affluent existence is merely a facade. The philandering of her suave doctor father, Louis (Samuel L. Jackson), creates a rift, throwing Eve's mother, Roz (Lynn Whitfield), and teenage sister, Cisely (Meagan Good), into emotional turmoil. Eve, though, manages to find some solace with her quirky psychic aunt, Mozelle (Debbi Morgan).

Once they fell in love, Melinda molded herself into everything he wanted her to be. She sacrificed for him, worked to support his grandiose dreams, and put up with him for better or for worse. Then, one day she realized that after all she had done, another woman was reaping the lavish rewards. That's when Melinda lost it, and now she cannot let it go.

programme.title: Temptation: Confessions of a Marriage Counselor

Having just completed her graduate work in psychotherapy, she's eager to begin a career as a marriage counselor. She takes an internship at a matchmaking firm for millionaires and meets Harley (Robbie Jones), a charismatic client who makes no effort to hide his attraction to Judith. Judith succumbs to his charms, placing her marriage in jeopardy.

When his drug-dealing ex-wife wins custody of the girls in court, he enlists the help of Julia (Gabrielle Union), a successful attorney, to get the girls back. Romance unexpectedly blooms between the pair, but the couple must come to terms with their very different lives and find a way to keep Monty's family together.

Wesley offers to help Lindsey get back on her feet and, though he's already engaged, romantic sparks begin to fly. Suddenly, Wesley finds himself torn between what is expected of him and what he really wants.
